notes.title: Activation code compensation notification
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585220/124596d12e6ca7a7359ff3dfe05d7d0cd9b794b2.png"][/img][b]Notice:[/b] The update of KingComing has been temporarily suspended. Users who purchased KingComing before June 10th and did not apply for a refund can contact me through Steam with their purchase records to receive a free activation code for the new game KillHer.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585220/50414dcf42009b8745531be43c9bc359554afb83.png"][/img][/p][p]Dear players, we apologize for the inconvenience caused by the many shortcomings of KingComing, which is our first game to be developed. After a period of polishing, we are about to launch a new game called "KillHer" on July 3rd. The quality of the game has been greatly improved, with rich video interactive content and an installation package size of nearly 2GB. Come and experience it for free now.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585220/4b6b94b3513ba923a9cc68dbf63536d028304c38.png"][/img][/p]
